description: A yield effect's own `inputs:` merge raw values straight into the top-level template scope, so a tag whose name matches one of the value's own attributes never resolves to Python's description of that attribute: `{{#title}}{{title}}{{/title}}` over the string "Intro" renders the string, not `str.title`; a list section over `["a", "b"]` using `{{count}}`/`{{index}}` (both `str` methods) falls through to the enclosing scope's own `count`/`index` keys on every pass; `{{d.year}}` on a date still resolves (a named data attribute); `{{d.isoformat}}` (a method) is a miss and renders empty; `{{#d}}{{isoformat}}{{/d}}` falls through to the enclosing scope's own `isoformat` key.
